speaker: Raj
text: So when do I start? You know, he's British, I'm Indian. Ever since Gandhi, they haven't liked us very much.

speaker: Howard
text: What do you mean you didn't get the job? How could you not get it? Are you saying that he discriminated against you? Because we should file a complaint.

speaker: Raj
text: That's okay. Complaint's been filed. So that's it. That was my last hope. I'm gonna be deported, sent home in disgrace, exposed to the sardonic barbs of my cousin Sanjay, or as you may know him, Dave from AT&T customer service.

speaker: Raj
text: Will you come visit me in India?

speaker: Howard
text: Gee, that's like a seventeen-hour flight. How about I meet you halfway?

speaker: Raj
text: Halfway's six hundred miles off the coast of Japan.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Gentlemen. Raj, did you get the job with Professor Laughlin? I assumed as much, but never fear. Like the subordinate male protagonist in countless action movies who disappears halfway through the second reel, I have returned to save the day.
